column3: The ceiling checks (users.go:336-416) and SoD set-check (:363) target a principal that does not exist until CreateUserWithRoleGrants (:365) commits it and its grants atomically, so no concurrent grant can address it; the flagged AddPasswordHistory (:378) is a best-effort history row. Residual: a concurrently created SoD policy can miss the new user — common to every grant path; see #2564.
